prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: wide horizontal website connection artwork with native transparent alpha background, approximately 3:1 landscape
Primary request: a photorealistic cutout of two hands reaching toward one another: a real human hand entering from the LEFT edge and a polished mirror-chrome robot hand entering from the RIGHT edge.
Composition/framing: the human forearm is cropped flush by the LEFT edge, human hand extends rightward. The chrome robotic forearm is cropped flush by the RIGHT edge, robot hand extends leftward. The two extended index fingertips point directly at each other, ending at the exact horizontal center of the image with a small elegant gap between them, about two percent of the image width. Fingertips are around the central vertical midline. The human hand stays wholly in the LEFT half and robot hand stays wholly in the RIGHT half, separated by transparent space. Other fingers curl naturally and gracefully beneath the index finger. Both wrists and parts of forearms visible. This is an elegant near-touch connection gesture.
Style/medium: realistic studio photographic cutout, lifelike human skin and anatomically correct hands, physically plausible robot finger joints and precision metal components.
Lighting/mood: refined neutral studio highlights, realistic skin detail, crisp silver metal with restrained cobalt-blue reflections.
Constraints: transparent background with actual alpha; absolutely no background, no backdrop, no checkerboard baked into pixels, no shadows on any background. Only two hands and forearms. Exactly five fingers on each hand. No faces, no bodies, no text, no writing, no logos, no Nokia word or logo, no watermarks, no decorative glow or particles, no border. Keep the fingertips at the exact horizontal center with a small gap.
